name: Claude Code Setup Guide
body:
> Guide · 2026-05-21

# Summary
Step-by-step guide prepared for Kim to install and run Claude Code on Windows 11 using Git Bash. The file is dated by modified date (May 21 2026). The companion script `_generate_setup_guide.js` in the same folder generated the docx and is not a note.

# Steps covered
1. **Prerequisites:** Node.js v18+ (LTS installer, keep "Add to PATH"), Git Bash (Git for Windows), an Anthropic account (same login as claude.ai).
2. **Install:** `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, then `claude --version`. On permission errors, do not use sudo; run Git Bash as administrator.
3. **First login:** run `claude`, authorize in the browser, return to the terminal. Authentication is per machine and stored under `C:\Users\kimbe\.claude\`.
4. **Verify:** open a project folder (example: `/c/TAG Marketing Claude/Summit Plumbing Pros`), ask Claude to list files, exit with `/exit` or Ctrl+D.
5. **Config and memory locations:** `C:\Users\kimbe\.claude\` holds `settings.json`, `projects\` per-project folders and auto-memory. TAG memory lives in `C:\Users\kimbe\.claude\projects\C--TAG-Marketing-Claude\memory\` with `MEMORY.md` as the index.
6. **Common commands:** `/help`, `/config`, `/clear`, `/exit`, `/init`, `/review`; from the shell: `claude`, `claude --version`, `npm update -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`.
7. **Existing connections at the time:** SSH alias `summit` (SiteGround, ed25519 key uploaded by Scott) and the Instantly AI API key configured 2026-05-19 (key not reproduced here).
8. **Troubleshooting:** "command not found" (reopen Git Bash, check Node), npm permission errors, browser not opening during login, full reinstall (warning: deleting `.claude` removes memory files).
